reviewTrigger: docs Worker build, runtime, provider composition, stage, deployment, teardown, rollback, proof or receipt change

journeys.claim: The exact deployable Worker/assets candidate runs under local workerd with the DCD-001 behavioral and lifecycle contract.
falseGreenOracles: the exact deployment input digest is retained
local readiness timing is not provider startup proof

journeys.claim: One trusted exact PR head is deployed to its isolated read-back workers.dev Preview, behaviorally proved and safely torn down.
falseGreenOracles: the candidate must be the provider-read-back trusted PR head
screenshots do not replace behavioral or provider proof
destroy must target only the exact stage

journeys.claim: The Preview-accepted exact source is rebuilt through the fixed Production stage and proved at its stable read-back workers.dev URL.
falseGreenOracles: same-source rebuild is not byte identity
the URL comes from provider readback
screenshots do not prove deployment or behavior

journeys.claim: An operator can restore the last-known-good Production source through the admitted normal redeploy path and prove provider/runtime agreement.
falseGreenOracles: a version change without hosted proof is insufficient
rollback must not change stage or Worker identity
break-glass reconciliation is not normal rollback
